name: Ubuntu 24.04
description: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Noble Numbat) as a cloud image, supported until 2029.

notes.text: Cloud-Init is enabled by default. Configure your SSH key and credentials in the Proxmox Cloud-Init tab before starting the VM.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
